facts.fact: 海伦娜想不通哈姆雷特怎么会同时是辛西娅的魔宠。
facts.anchor: So how the bloody hell is he Cynthia’s familiar as well?

facts.fact: 罗温解释说魔宠选两个女巫，是因为两人的灵魂交织在一起。
facts.anchor: Those witches are bound to each other. Separate souls woven together as one.

facts.fact: 辛西娅掌心聚起一小团风暴后，克莱奥断定她确实是女巫。
facts.anchor: Cynthia is most definitely a witch.

facts.fact: 罗温讲 1629 年女巫遭屠杀时，有女巫用血魔法封住自己的力量。
facts.anchor: she used blood magic to block her own powers.

facts.fact: 辛西娅把寡妇身份说成不再受他人支配。
facts.anchor: A widow is beholden to no one but herself.

facts.fact: 辛西娅让三株植物恢复生机，罗温称她是地巫。
facts.anchor: I think we have another earthwitch among us!

facts.fact: 克莱奥临走前对辛西娅说海伦娜已经半爱上她。
facts.anchor: She’s half in love with you already.

facts.fact: 海伦娜对辛西娅说两人不能是灵魂伴侣，辛西娅骂她固执、害怕、愚蠢后上楼。
facts.anchor: But our souls cannot be intertwined. It’s impossible.
